resolution: Built the wall-mounted (through-the-wall) ATM variant as model package atm_wall via the agent seat, complementing the freestanding atm prop. Fascia is 0.55x0.85x0.18m spanning y 0.85-1.70 with the BACK FACE flush at z=0 so it surface-snaps flat against any wall with the screen at eye height. Recessed dark-blue screen (manual hairline-extrude + two-axis shrink; the packaged inset action rejected its y-shrink so the equivalent manual sequence was used), protruding card_slot, keypad, and cash_slot applique parts, stainless base coat with painted details at atlas fit 1024. All 56 faces durably named (fascia, screen.cap, card_slot, keypad, cash_slot, sides/back); save + semantic-status healthy; visual verified via self-shot.
